title: Character Profiler 1.1.0 Release Candidate 2
notes:
Character Profiler 1.1.0 Release Candidate 2 is the physical-device test build for the polished iPhone interface.

It introduces a cohesive adaptive visual system across the Story Library, story workspace, character dashboard, editors, Character Guide, People & Relationships, History and Visual Studio, with clearer hierarchy, gradient hero cards, semantic accent colours and improved light/dark appearance.

There is no SwiftData schema or Character Profiler archive-format change; archive format remains v1. Physical-device Image Playground output quality, interface ergonomics and cross-angle identity consistency remain explicit validation items.

The attached IPA is intentionally unsigned for AltStore, AltServer, Sideloadly or another sideloading tool to apply the user's development signature during installation.
